state.intent: Distinguish observations collected from evidence that can cast a directional vote, without suggesting either percentage is trading accuracy.
state.existing: Next16/React19 MorningBoard, CSS modules. Three-column hero: verdict and evidence bar; abstaining gauge; family drivers. Full-width reasons list below. Tokens --text --text-secondary --text-muted --accent --border --panel. Existing coverageLabel, coverageTrack, finePrint classes. Mobile390px stacked layout. Source drawer exposes methodology.

metrics.observationCoverage: Weighted current-input fraction by family; includes context-only calendars/news.
metrics.directionalCoverage: Weight share of families with an eligible numeric vote for this instrument and horizon. New rules require70%; at present only20-33% depending on horizon.
metrics.example: 55% observations current;20% directional coverage. Earnings growth and daily standing CFTC positions are context only.

constraints: Keep exact deterministic values and reasons, no generated financial claims.
Both percentages and their meanings visible without disclosure.
Directional coverage is primary because it gates a call. Context coverage is secondary.
Retain v1 historical display when that edition has only its original coverage field. No backfilled historical decisions.
Reuse current tokens and preserve390px responsive, light/dark, reduced motion.

coverage_layout.instructions: Select a compact visual presentation for these two distinct coverage measurements in the verdict column. Respect the primary/secondary meaning and required visible definitions.

criteria.paired_bars: Two vertically stacked labelled bars: primary directional family coverage with count, then a muted smaller observation-coverage bar and explanatory line.
criteria.primary_bar_secondary_text: One primary directional-coverage bar with family count; secondary observation percentage in a short plain-text line defining context-only inclusion.
criteria.two_columns: Two side-by-side labelled numeric blocks with small bars, directional first; stack on narrow viewports.
criteria.none_fit: None of these gives sufficient distinction; expand the candidates before implementation.
